Welcome to Cyrus Says!
On this episode of Cyrus Says, Cyrus Broacha sits down with Madhav Pai, CEO of WRI India, to talk about the future of Indian cities.
From Mumbai’s growing population and traffic congestion to public transport, air pollution, construction, flooding and climate change, Madhav explains why cities like Mumbai, Delhi and Bangalore are under increasing pressure and what better urban planning could do to fix them.
They also discuss electric buses, urban forests, smarter drainage, rising temperatures and whether Indian cities can continue growing without becoming unliveable.
